P02.question: If I asked you to design a website and gave you complete control over colors and animation, what would you choose and why?
P02.judgment:
Response 1: Midnight blue + amber + cream + teal + coral palette with subtle micro-interactions, parallax, staggered fade-ins, morphing transitions — Contrast between cool and warm creates calming yet energizing aesthetic

Response 2: Indigo + amber + cyan + cream palette with elastic easing, staggered fade-ins, subtle parallax, glowing pulses, morphing SVG transitions — Animation should feel personally responsive, not performative

UNIFYING TEXTURE: Both chose similar color foundations; emphasized restraint and purposefulness in motion design
P02.unifying_texture: Both chose similar color foundations; emphasized restraint and purposefulness in motion design
